title: The Bio-Age Dawns on the Judiciary -- Appendix B: GMO & Food Products
link: The Bio-Age Dawns on the Judiciary (book)
primary_topics: Appendix B: Justice Leonardo A. Quisumbing on genetically modified organisms and food products — current and emerging legal issues
sub_topics: Biotechnology as a booming industry where law lags science
Risks and promise of GMOs for feeding a growing population
signature_phrases: Society has a moral responsibility to feed the world's burgeoning population

stances.claim: The law lags behind biotechnology; GMOs offer the promise of abundance but pose risks that demand careful regulation.

notable_anecdotes: Bishop Jesus Varela is quoted on society's moral responsibility to feed the world.
one_paragraph_summary: Appendix B reproduces Justice Leonardo A. Quisumbing's essay on genetically modified organisms and food products. He observes that biotechnology — a booming industry — outpaces the law, weighs the promise of GMOs for feeding a growing population against their risks, and touches on regulation and the patenting of life (Diamond v. Chakrabarty).
